pages.title: Three Categories
pages.text: With JEI installed: $(l)129 alchemy$(), $(l)73 refinement$() and $(l)24 talisman$() recipes. Materials and outputs reuse the server resolve plan; unresolvable author rows are omitted instead of faked.

pages.title: Catalysts
pages.text: All five furnace tiers, G1–G3 forges and the talisman table are catalysts. The furnace progress region opens alchemy recipes. Remote clients use the packaged alchemy manifest; runtime reloads override/extend by id.

pages.title: Caveats
pages.text: JEI shows authority materials (talisman ink included). Live craft still needs formed operational stations, life-skill gates and realm checks. Failures and full bags use refunds/outbox, not JEI simulation.
